lines.japanese: 「……帰ってきた」
lines.english: “...I'm back.”

lines.japanese: 「私は帰ってきたぞ、みんな！　グレタガルドに栄光あれ！　ロイヒテン・グレタ！」
lines.english: “I have returned, my friends! Glory to Gretagard! Light upon Gretagard!”

lines.japanese: 「きゃーっ！　ホーク素敵ィィィ！」
lines.english: “Eee! Hawk, you're so wonderful!”

lines.japanese: 「ホーク様ー！　こっち向いてー！」
lines.english: “Lord Hawk! Look this way!”

lines.japanese: 「時は来た！　私はグレタガルドに永久の安寧をもたらすため、いま白き闇の国を発ってきたのだ！　もはやかの地に戻ることはない、我が生涯をグレタガルドに捧げるとここに誓おう！」
lines.english: “The hour has come! To bring eternal peace to Gretagard, I have this day departed the Land of White Darkness! Nevermore shall I return to that place. Here and now, I swear to devote my life to Gretagard!”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、愛しのホークったら、なんだってそんな決断を！？」
lines.english: “Oh, my beloved Hawk! Whatever moved you to such a decision?”

lines.japanese: 「皆のためです。私は私が必要とされる場所に骨を埋めたいのです」
lines.english: “For all of you. I wish to lay my bones in the land where I am needed.”

lines.japanese: 「本当ですか！　本当に私たちを裏切らないのですか！」
lines.english: “Is it true? You truly won't betray us?”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、そんな心配は無用さ。私は過去に執着しない男だからな。どうせ卒業旅行にも謝恩会の二次会にも呼ばれなかったのだ、もはや向こうの世界に何の未練があろうものか」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! You needn't worry. I am a man who does not cling to the past. They invited me neither on the graduation trip nor to the banquet after-party. What attachment could I possibly have left to that other world?”

lines.japanese: 「機は熟せり。さあ見よ、皆の者。あれぞ忌むべき翼人兵どもの籠る“水鏡の塔”だ」
lines.english: “The time is ripe. Behold, my friends! There stands the Tower of the Water Mirror, where those accursed winged soldiers lie in wait.”

lines.japanese: 「ハイヤー！　行くぞ同志、我に続け！　全軍、突撃ィーッ！」
lines.english: “Hiyah! Come, comrades—follow me! All forces, chaaaarge!”

lines.japanese: 「ああホーク、貴方はなんて頼もしいおひとなの！」
lines.english: “Oh, Hawk! What a gallant, dependable man you are!”

lines.japanese: 「最高ーッ！　ホーク最高ー！　抱いてー！　今すぐ抱いてー！」
lines.english: “You're the best! Hawk, you're the best! Take me! Take me right now!”

lines.japanese: 「私も私もー！」
lines.english: “Me too! Me too!”

lines.japanese: 「俺も俺もー！」
lines.english: “Me too! Me too!”

lines.japanese: 「ホーク！　ホーク！　サー・ホーク！　ホーク！　ホーク！　サー・ホーク！」
lines.english: “Hawk! Hawk! Sir Hawk! Hawk! Hawk! Sir Hawk!”

lines.japanese: 私は最後の戦いに駆けだした。
lines.english: I charged into the final battle.

lines.japanese: すべてを終わらせるために。翼ある者たちとの決別を果たすために。
lines.english: To bring it all to an end. To part forever from the winged ones.

lines.japanese: 僕だけの世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: *May peace prevail in a world that’s mine alone.*

lines.japanese: 「グレタカリ・バーニング！　縦横微塵斬りィィィー！」
lines.english: “Gretacali Burning Crisscross Mincemeat Slash!”

lines.japanese: 「ふむ……しかしこの辺りも随分と見違えたものだ」
lines.english: “Hmm... This land, too, has changed beyond recognition.”

lines.japanese: 「水鏡の塔もまた然り。ううむ、美しい。綺羅と輝く宝石の嵌めこまれたる様がまたなんとも見事。いかな辣腕のドワーフ工とて、あれほど精巧な意匠を凝らすことはできまいて」
lines.english: “The Tower of the Water Mirror most of all. Mmm, beautiful. Those gems set into its walls, sparkling in all their splendor—magnificent. Not even the most masterful dwarven artisan could devise so exquisite a design.”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん……？」
lines.english: “Big brother...?”

lines.japanese: 「おお、麗しのプリンセス。いかがなされました」
lines.english: “Ah, my radiant princess. What troubles you?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん、これ切符。ちゃんとポケットに入れてね。なくしちゃだめだよ。乗れなくなっちゃうからね」
lines.english: “Oh, um, here's your ticket. Put it safely in your pocket, okay? Don't lose it. You won't be able to get on without it.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ、まったく面目ございません。我が愛馬エヴリバディ・ハヴァ・ウイング号がおれば、かの修道院への旅程などほんの二日足らずで済んだところを」
lines.english: “Ah! I have brought shame upon myself. Had my faithful steed Everybody Have a Wing been here, the journey to yon monastery would have taken less than two days.”

lines.japanese: 「だいじょぶだよ、特急なら一時間くらいだから」
lines.english: “It's okay. The express only takes about an hour.”

lines.japanese: 「なんと！　流石ですな、姫！　それほど高度な移動魔法を習得なさっていたとは、いやはや──」
lines.english: “What! Just as one would expect of you, Princess! To think you had mastered transportation magic of such an advanced order! Good heavens—”

lines.japanese: 「しーっ。お兄ちゃん、声おっきいよ？　お話のせんせいにも言われたでしょ？　あとほら、あんまりのんびりしてたら門限、間に合わなくなっちゃうから。ね、いそごうね」
lines.english: “Shh. You’re talking too loud, big brother. Remember what your speech teacher told you? And if we keep dawdling, we’re going to miss curfew. Come on. Let’s hurry, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「はっ！　参りましょう、我が帰るべき場所へ！」
lines.english: “Yes! Let us depart for the place where I belong!”
